2.name: Promises, Promises
2.overview: When Emmett continues his nightly check-ins with Bobbie to ensure her safety, Isabella pays the price as she's kept up by their loud late-night chats, prompting her to tell Bobbie to advance their relationship. Or at least take it out of the house.

2.name: I've Got a Secret
2.overview: After Bobbie and Emmett’s big moment, Bobbie is still unsure how Emmett truly feels about her, prompting Bobbie to do the unthinkable and give Emmett a birthday gift. Gabby tries to convince Isabella to give her the family discount on Happy’s house.

2.name: Straw Man
2.overview: When Gabby asks Bobbie to help vet men to be her potential donor, Bobbie is happy to participate until she discovers Gabby is considering Emmett for the donation. Isabella is asked to be the guest speaker for Takoda's daughter's class.

2.name: Testing, Testing
2.overview: After Bobbie notices how much Isabella misses school, she signs them both up for an online course unaware of how serious Isabella would take it. Gabby wears Isabella's old Stanford sweatshirt, tricking customers into believing she went there.

2.name: Mouse in the House
2.overview: After Gabby accidentally lets a mouse loose in the tavern, Bobbie must distract the health inspector by any means necessary as everyone tries to find the mouse and secure their "A" rating.

2.name: Izzy and the Professor
2.overview: Bobbie interferes when Isabella starts dating someone from her class; Takoda finds a customer's phone in the bathroom, and Gaby and Steve spy on the messages and voicemails from that phone.

2.name: An Accountant Prepares...
2.overview: Bobbie pushes Steve into auditioning for a local commercial to keep him busy, not realizing she signed herself up to be his scene partner; Isabella gives Emmett notes on his new appetizer for the tavern.

2.name: The Name Given
2.overview: Bobbie doesn't want Gabby to get her hopes up too soon about her potential pregnancy, but accidentally rains on her parade in the process; Isabella hires Takoda's band to play at the tavern unaware he's in a death metal band.

2.name: Silence Was Golden
2.overview: Bobbie attempts to plan the perfect anniversary dinner for her and Emmett.

2.name: No
2.overview: When Bobbie alerts Isabella to an easy way for the tavern to make some extra cash, she's shocked when Isabella tells her no; Gabby becomes obsessed with a bar game that Takoda brought in.

2.name: Dart to the Heart
2.overview: Bobbie tries to help Emmett and Isabella reconnect by forcing them into a darts tournament.

2.name: Social Discontent
2.overview: Steve and Isabella shoot content for the tavern, but soon find Bobbie has a case of camera madness.

2.name: A New Chapter
2.overview: Gabby's mom Val arrives unexpectedly. Bobbie helps Gabby handle their complicated relationship. Isabella and Steve investigate whether Gabby's childhood stories are really that terrible.

2.name: Borrowin' Trouble
2.overview: Bobbie and Isabella plan to help Monica inspect the speakeasy while avoiding Emmett; Steve and Takoda meet Emmett at the fishing shack after Gabby suggests he's upset with them.

2.name: Emotional Real Estate
2.overview: When Bobbie struggles to find the perfect buyers for Happy's house, Gabby has the solution.

2.name: AI-AI-No
2.overview: Steve discovers he can replace himself with AI after finding ways for the tavern to save money.

2.name: Everybody's a Critic
2.overview: When Bobbie lets Isabella try giving the staff a "compliment sandwich" during their performance reviews, nobody is pleased with the outcome.

2.name: Couples Counseling
2.overview: After Bobbie starts serving patrons at the speakeasy, Isabella accuses her of stealing customers, causing the sisters to attend couples counseling; Emmett tries his best to gently break up with Monica.

3.name: Office/Space
3.overview: Bobbie surprises Isabella with her own office upstairs and reassures her that they'll still see each other plenty. Steve and Takoda try to convince Emmett to stop giving Bobbie so much space after their relationship has moved into the friend zone.

3.name: Skeletons in the Closet
3.overview: Unresolved feelings about their late father arise when Bobbie and Isabella put a photo of Happy on their ofrenda for Dia De Los Muertos. Emmett tries to avoid Gabby's Halloween pranks at all costs.

3.name: Full Gabby
3.overview: After Bobbie notices Val shutting down all of Gabby's ideas, she confronts Gabby's mother only to have Val point out that Bobbie does the same thing. Steve tries some new tactics to manage his OCD on an unknowing Isabella.
